arcs.title: The Subcommittee's Jurisdiction Problem
arcs.summary: Day 3: The Subcommittee assigned the Room provisional reference number 00-441-GF-7703-RMX-19 without having visited it. Cresswell's mapping party still cannot locate the spur. Christine responded to the third memo with a single sentence — 'The Room does not require a number' — delivered at half past four Friday. Undersecretary Prentice-Hoole has called a further session for Monday. Junior clerk Tibbs, who voted against the number and was reassigned, has asked to be reinstated. Day 4 should be the resolution: Christine's patience has now fully taken the shape of a decision. She should either deliver a definitive closing statement that ends the Subcommittee's claim entirely — perhaps citing an obscure Gringotts precedent, or simply invoking the fact that the Room cannot be administered by people who cannot find it — or the Subcommittee should quietly, somewhat sheepishly, withdraw. Tibbs should be redeemed in some small, satisfying way.
